description: One unit's unregistered engine literals still allowed (LT1, D-063 style, D-064 a), per file, kind and value, written by `python3 scripts/lib/literal_census.py --write`. scripts/structure-check fails when the census of the scanned files differs from this directory or a unit allows a value more times than the base branch. A PR that removes literals deletes their entries; nothing adds one. The total is computed, never stored.
